name: Suspension-insulator conductor reference
summary: Identifies the suspended conductor support used at the assigned yard connection.
description: Identifies the suspended conductor support used at the assigned yard connection. High-voltage primary equipment carries, interrupts, measures or conditions the main power circuit. Its function, insulation arrangement and equipment boundaries need to be distinguished from the secondary signals used to control it.

In a switchyard equipment diagram, the primary reference identifies the electrical role of an installed component while the linked equipment schedule and manufacturer drawing supply its exact construction and dimensions. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Suspended primary conductor” at the input and “Insulated suspension interface” at the output. Mechanical loading belongs to the structural design.

Read the connected power path before interpreting a secondary output or alarm. These original educational component references provide no product dimensions, dielectric rating, installation clearance or construction approval. The functional block is an independent explanation of this named application. Equipment-specific ratings, terminal connections and operating conditions must be established in the project documentation.
